component.name: DesuIndex
component.summary: Sort anime images by facial expression using AI

description.p: DesuIndex classifies anime images by detected facial expressions — happy, sad, angry, surprised, neutral, and more — using an ONNX-based AI model. Browse thumbnails, reassign misclassified images, then copy, move or symlink them into one folder per expression, in your Pictures folder or anywhere you choose.

ul.li: Uses the more accurate WD EVA02-Large Tagger v3 model
Better at telling happy, smug and embarrassed faces apart
Images without a clear expression go into an "other" folder, which can also be picked by hand
Processing a folder can be stopped partway, keeping the images already done
Pick which expressions to sort into, and every image goes to the closest one
GIFs are sorted too, judged across the whole animation
Images can be sorted as links, leaving the originals where they are
Can scan the folders inside the one you open, too
Can remember sorted images, so opening a folder again skips them
Transparent images and rotated photos are tagged correctly
Only has access to the Pictures folder by default
